related.title: GPU 持續負載：時脈、熱降頻與有效吞吐
related.titleEn: GPU sustained load: clocks, thermal throttling and throughput
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：能量與token同時間窗，品質一致，未將TDP當實測或部分功率當全系統。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Energy/token windows align, quality matches, and TDP/components are not whole-system measurements.
related.difference: 使用整段產出計算平均吞吐，辨識溫度、功率限制與資料飢餓的不同證據。
related.differenceEn: Compute whole-run throughput and distinguish thermal, power and supply-starvation evidence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: E=PavgΔt，e=E/N；對變動功率需積分，不用某一瞬間峰值乘整段時間。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 平均牆端功率600 W，60 s輸出12000有效token；包含主機、記憶體和冷卻於此量測邊界。 能量36000 J；每token36000/12000=3 J。
總工作=Σrate_i×time_i；平均速率=總工作/總時間，不能平均不同長度區段而不加權。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 前20 s為100工作/s，後40 s為70工作/s，總60 s；速率是合成量。 總工作20×100+40×70=4800，平均80工作/s。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: E=PavgΔt and e=E/N; varying power requires integration, not peak power times duration. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Average wall power600 W, 60 s, 12000 valid tokens; the selected boundary includes host, memory and local cooling. Energy36000 J; 3 J/token.

Total work=Σrate×time; average rate is total work/time, not an unweighted mean of unequal intervals. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. First20 s at 100 work units/s, next40 s at 70, total 60 s; all rates synthetic. Work4800, mean 80 units/s.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: MobileNet：深度可分離卷積
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：能量與token同時間窗，品質一致，未將TDP當實測或部分功率當全系統。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Energy/token windows align, quality matches, and TDP/components are not whole-system measurements.
related.difference: 先畫16個互不混通道的3×3核，再畫16→32的1×1混合；標深度倍率。；兩段MAC合計正確，通道脈衝測試無跨通道洩漏；品質驗證資料分割固定。
related.differenceEn: Draw16 independent3×3 filters followed by a16→32 pointwise mixer; label the depth multiplier.; Both MAC sums match and depthwise impulses show no cross-channel leakage; hold the validation split fixed.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: E=PavgΔt，e=E/N；對變動功率需積分，不用某一瞬間峰值乘整段時間。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 平均牆端功率600 W，60 s輸出12000有效token；包含主機、記憶體和冷卻於此量測邊界。 能量36000 J；每token36000/12000=3 J。
每位置MAC=k²Cin+CinCout；對標準卷積k²CinCout比值為1/Cout+1/k²。；教學k=3,Cin=16,Cout=32，深度倍率1。；MAC=9×16+16×32=656；Cout=64時1168。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: E=PavgΔt and e=E/N; varying power requires integration, not peak power times duration. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Average wall power600 W, 60 s, 12000 valid tokens; the selected boundary includes host, memory and local cooling. Energy36000 J; 3 J/token.
MACs per position are k²Cin+CinCout; the ratio to standard convolution is1/Cout+1/k².; Teaching k=3,Cin=16,Cout=32, depth multiplier one.; MAC=9×16+16×32=656; Cout=64 gives1168.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
